criteria.reason: For unbound pre-Prepared drain work, intent_crash_boundaries' five new tests prove retained-input resumption takes only the existing precommitted route and unavailable-input takes only the existing guarded pre-prepared abort/unbound-erase route, with no synthetic bytes or ContentPrepared-only marker -- an active drain adds no new per-intent behavior, it only observes. ResultPrepared always Parks (never abandons) under an active drain exactly as it does without one, and reconcile correctly stays Draining while it does. Bound never abandons: a Bound intent present before a drain is never stamped and still promotes to Live. Built and evidenced fresh 2026-09-17 by P05-I.
